rows.behavior: ci.yml is named CI and runs prek, then knowledge, then the kmctl, kmaudit, repo and starter jobs, each test job running pytest in its own directory.
rows.fails_when: the name is not CI, a job is missing, the needs order differs, or a test job runs the wrong directory

rows.behavior: A tests job needs kmctl, kmaudit and repo, runs if: always(), and fails unless every one succeeded; prek, knowledge and tests carry no name: so the required checks keep their names.
rows.fails_when: the tests job is missing, lacks always(), passes when one job failed or was skipped, or a required job has a name:

rows.behavior: Every test the loop's tests gate collects sits under exactly one CI test job's directory, each job directory collects at least one test, and both packages appear.
rows.fails_when: a collected test is in no job or in two, a job collects nothing, or a package is missing
